producer_report.summary: The six open findings are fixed in the study data and site.rs. "Agent" now means firstmate's deciding AI and "worker" means the separate AI tool that does a task. The page says "decided by agent" means the former. t4's agent trigger no longer names the merge landing. The t10 card explains why a yolo merge is drawn Ready to Ready, citing claims c12, c13 and c29. Reopened's terminal-success tag shows as "ends the task", and the states lead-in explains Reopened. Finding f2 is removed, and the model-limit and could-not-run finding tags get plain labels. "In scope" is defined in the start terms and the glossary, and the page says the cited instruction gives no test for it. A "Next step" link near the top points to the Next steps section. site.rs has a test for each. CHANGELOG.md has an entry. I added no new claims, so claims.json and validation.json are unchanged. The full `cargo test --locked` output was too long to read in this session, and I read only the xtask package's results. Both fixture-based xtask test targets passed. Earlier in this session I saw no failure line in the part of the full run I could read.

checks_run.note: The full output was too long to read in this session. I read the xtask package run: 33 tests passed, plus 9 policy and 6 walltime tests. I saw no failure.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`. Site tests pass and show three things. First, no transition marked 'decided by agent' has a trigger that names another decider's event, so t4's trigger is split or re-attributed. Second, the deciding agent and the worker agents use two different terms, and the page says which one 'decided by agent' means. Third, the page contains a glossary entry for 'in scope'.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test --locked -p xtask` passes 33 tests. These include no_transition_decided_by_the_agent_names_another_deciders_event, the_page_uses_agent_for_the_decider_and_worker_for_the_task_doer_and_says_which_is_which and in_scope_is_defined_in_the_start_terms_and_the_glossary_with_a_citation.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test`. A site test shows the reopened state no longer carries the bare 'terminal-success' tag, or the tag is explained on the page. A second site test shows a link to the next step appears in the HTML before the first transition card.

The t10 card explains why the yolo merge is drawn ready to ready while t4 takes a merge to done, citing a claim whose source is firstmate at the pinned SHA. If that source shows the drawing is wrong, model.json changes instead, with the citation.
criteria_check.evidence: model.json t10 summary explains it and cites c12, c13 and c29. Test the_t10_card_explains_why_a_merge_stays_ready_and_cites_claims passes.

criteria_check.criterion: The f2 model-limit note is removed, or rewritten in plain words a newcomer can follow. No newcomer-facing text mentions a model limit without explaining it.
criteria_check.evidence: f2 is removed from findings.json. The model-limit and could-not-run finding tags have plain labels. the_real_study_shows_failures_and_limits_and_no_placeholder_guard passes.

criteria_check.criterion: 'In scope' is defined where it first appears in intro.json (green terms, the 'what' text and the t10 summary), and a glossary entry for it cites a claim sourced at the pinned SHA. Every new statement about firstmate cites an existing or new claim.
criteria_check.evidence: intro.json defines it in the start terms and the glossary, citing existing claims. The test for the in-scope definition passes. The site build rejects uncited intro elements, and it ran without error.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`. It builds the page and validates the study without error. Run `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`. Both are clean.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo run -p xtask -- site` wrote index.html. `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --all --check` produced no warnings and no diffs.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry for this change. The items already fixed in bca96fc (captain, yolo, home, ra1 to ra6, lede study id) are not reworked.
criteria_check.evidence: The CHANGELOG.md Unreleased section has a Changed entry. The diff touches none of the captain, yolo, home, ra1-ra6 or lede fixes.

open_issues: The instruction cited for "in scope" gives no test for what counts as in scope. The page says so rather than inventing one.
learnings: The Bash tool here cannot use grep or pipes, and cannot read its saved output files, so a long `cargo test` output cannot be read in full.
